mapper.select: SELECT log_id AS logId, loss_id AS billId, loss_no AS billNo, before_status AS fromStatus, after_status AS toStatus, operate_type AS operateType, operate_by AS operateBy, operate_name AS operateName, operate_remark AS remark, operate_time AS operateTime FROM wms_loss_status_log WHERE loss_id = #{billId} ORDER BY operate_time ASC
